title: Implement chat-recorder steering injection
description: Pass the procedure chat recorder into DSPy agents and inject pending steering messages into agent history before the next LLM call. Validate with focused tests and push a feature branch for GitHub CI.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Added focused tests for chat-recorder steering injection: runtime setup now asserts chat_recorder is passed into agent config; DSPy agent tests assert steering messages append a system message and advance per-agent watermark, including the no-message watermark path.
